entries.en: V, you are to rescue Lauren Costigan – wife of Bradley Costigan, my client. She is being held captive by the Tyger Claws.
entries.ro: V, trebuie să o salvezi pe Lauren Costigan – soția lui Bradley Costigan, clientul meu. E ținută captivă de gașca Tyger Claws.

entries.en: If you wish to know more, read the attachment.
